failure_taxonomy.onednn_primitive_failure: The exception text contains 'could not execute a primitive' or primitive_onednn_base.
failure_taxonomy.memory_wall: CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES, or an explicit allocation error (out of memory, bad_alloc, cannot allocate, not enough memory, MemoryError, failed to allocate, allocation failure). No other marker, including an access-violation code, is memory_wall.
failure_taxonomy.record_at_failure: Every memory_* field present on the result, and the rung (n_cached).
failure_taxonomy.point_failure_is_data: A cell whose points end with a failure_kind completes with status partial and the boot continues to the next cell. The boot stops only on a guard failure: a measurement gate, canary drift, an unarmed canary, or a harness exception.

resident_46000_feasibility.supporting_wall_source: 69234ed5-a716-4274-b851-33509bdb9972 gpu_only_u8 n=4250 r0 memory_at_failure.rss_mb, failure_kind memory_wall, text CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES. Host available_mb at that failure was still 5418.65625.
derivation: Host-visible RSS growth during a completed generate tracks k_plus_w. On e9264a0a n=12000 f16, RSS grew from memory_before_generate.rss_mb 2543.57421875 to memory_after_generate.rss_mb 5208.96875, a growth of 2665.39453125 MB. 12000 * 234827 / 1048576 = 2687.381744384766 MB.

On 69234ed5 the same growth from n=2000 to n=4062 is 760.35546875 - 407.48828125 = 352.8671875 MB over 2062 tokens, 179441.35 B/token, next to the 4B u8 slope 171532. The 8B model is larger, so its slope is higher. n=4062 completed. n=4250 raised CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES at RSS 5928.0078125. n=5000 and n=8000 raised 'could not execute a primitive' with host available_mb still 5824.39453125 and 4723.82421875. The primitive error is the same class past that allocation wall, not a separate host-OOM class.
Cold f16 n=46000 in sealed 2b3316b6 completed. That session's available_mb_start_median at 46000 was 12012.92578125. It is not the resident memory state.

The resident model is rss_end = memory_before_generate.rss_mb + n * k_plus_w / 1048576, using the f16 failure session's pre-generate RSS 2568.234375 because every arm loads the same 2290768181-byte IR. The device wall is the failure RSS 6060.1875. The 8B CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES RSS 5928.0078125 is lower, so a prediction of fail against 6060.1875 is also a fail against the lower wall.

u4 at 46000: 2568.234375 + 46000 * 135000 / 1048576 = 8490.551879882812 MB. Above 6060.1875. Predicted fail. Host available_mb before the f16 generate was 6466.6796875 and the u4 growth 5922.3175048828125 would fit in that host figure; the binding constraint is the device RSS wall, which the 8B run hit while 5418.65625 MB was still reported available.
